detailed_description:
The target video is a retro screen-print collage pop-art animation with a pink, black and white palette, halftone dot textures, paper grain and beat-synced cuts at about 110 BPM.
[Shot 1] A black globe with a lat-long grid spins up from frame bottom, a graphic match on the globe of <Subject 2>. As it spins it reveals <Subject 1> inside a floating bubble of small hearts and stars, doing a playful shoulder shimmy on each beat, her dark hair with straight bangs bouncing. The camera tilts up from a low angle with small amplitude at slow speed.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.362, a cluster of halftone dots condenses at frame center and blooms into an extreme close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, a graphic match on the halftone texture of <Subject 2>. She winks on the downbeat, dark lips curved in a smirk, and mouths along with the music without singing aloud. The camera holds a static close-up with a very slow push-in.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.723, the shot cuts to a wide view: <Subject 1> leads <Subject 3>, a line of flat black paper-cut silhouette girls with identical bangs, all dancing in sync with a bouncy side-step on the beat. Stars fall like confetti past the halftone dots, the heart and the eye symbols float at the edges, and the camera cranes up slightly with small amplitude. The segment ends on this group formation, cut cleanly on the beat.

overall_soundscape:
Paper rustle and print-press clicks pulse with the beat, a light whoosh marks each match cut, and a subtle vinyl crackle runs throughout.
